subject_group: DATA DISPLAYED IN THE UAS CONTROL STATION

versions.text:
See AMC.1722 Many UAV System parameters or status indications are required in subpart H and I to be displayed, yet they may be only necessary or required in certain phases of flight.
(a) When parameters are not displayed full-time, flight safety must not be impaired.
(b) Part-time displays of UAV System parameters or status indicators must be shown not to create an unsafe conditions.
